title: Redis out of memory errors under peak traffic
symptoms: Redis returning OOM command not allowed errors. Memory maxed at 100%. Cache read hit rate plummeted to 12%.
rootCause: Volatile-lru eviction policy was misconfigured to noeviction during recent terraform migration.
lesson: Always verify redis eviction policy matches cluster role after infrastructure changes.

actions.actionDescription: Flushed all Redis keys using FLUSHALL
actions.observation: Downstream databases experienced immediate thundering herd traffic spike.
actions.explanation: Flushing the entire cache forced every downstream microservice to fetch data directly from the databases simultaneously, collapsing the primary read replicas.

actions.actionDescription: Set maxmemory-policy to allkeys-lru and doubled cache replica capacity
actions.observation: Memory stabilized at 82% and hit rates returned to 94%.
actions.explanation: Proper LRU eviction allowed redis to discard cold keys safely without stampeding backend databases.

title: Disk usage 100% on log volume /var/log
symptoms: Orders API pods crashing with disk I/O errors. File system is completely full on log mount.
rootCause: Debug level logging was left enabled on production payment interceptor.
lesson: Ensure logrotate runs every 15 minutes with maxsize cap and log levels are restricted.

actions.actionDescription: Deleted active log files using rm -rf /var/log/orders-api.log
actions.observation: Disk space was not reclaimed by the operating system.
actions.explanation: The JVM process still held open file handles to the unlinked file descriptors, preventing ext4 from reclaiming blocks.

actions.actionDescription: Truncated open log file with truncate -s 0 and restarted fluentd shipper
actions.observation: Disk usage dropped to 14% immediately.
actions.explanation: Truncating kept the file descriptor valid while immediately freeing allocated disk blocks.

title: DNS lookup timeout causing payment webhook drops
symptoms: Payments worker failing to reach Stripe gateway; UnknownHostException appearing in application logs.
rootCause: CoreDNS pods were overloaded due to aggressive ndots:5 configuration in Kubernetes.
lesson: Append trailing dot to external FQDNs and increase CoreDNS replicas with autoscaling.

actions.actionDescription: Added Stripe static IP directly to /etc/hosts on payment workers
actions.observation: TLS certificate validation failed for stripe.com API calls.
actions.explanation: Hardcoding IP caused requests to fail SNI routing and hit an IP that rotated within 10 minutes, completely blocking all payments.

actions.actionDescription: Scaled CoreDNS deployment from 2 to 8 replicas and enabled NodeLocal DNSCache
actions.observation: DNS latency fell below 1ms and payment webhooks succeeded.
actions.explanation: NodeLocal DNS eliminated cluster-wide CoreDNS UDP bottlenecks.

title: Database deadlocks on high concurrency checkout cart updates
symptoms: HTTP 500 spike during flash sale. MySQL error 1213: Deadlock found when trying to get lock.
rootCause: Cart items were being updated in random order by concurrent checkout threads.
lesson: Always sort entities by primary key ID before acquiring row locks in transactions.

actions.actionDescription: Increased transaction isolation level to SERIALIZABLE
actions.observation: Deadlock rate increased by 400% and transaction throughput collapsed.
actions.explanation: Higher isolation caused MySQL InnoDB to acquire extensive range locks, causing massive serialization conflicts across unrelated users.

actions.actionDescription: Sorted line items by product_id ascending before applying updates and added retry with jitter
actions.observation: Deadlocks dropped to zero even under 15,000 checkout req/sec.
actions.explanation: Consistent lock ordering across all concurrent transactions mathematically prevents deadlock cycles.

title: JVM garbage collection pauses exceeding 12 seconds
symptoms: Payments worker unresponsive; health check probes timing out; Stop-The-World GC pauses logged.
rootCause: Heap fragmentation caused by allocating massive 50MB byte arrays for uncompressed invoice PDFs.
lesson: Stream large binary payloads to object storage instead of loading into heap buffers.

actions.actionDescription: Increased heap size from 4GB to 16GB without changing GC collector
actions.observation: GC pause duration increased from 8s to 35s, causing Kubernetes to kill pods repeatedly.
actions.explanation: Larger heap with Serial/Parallel GC meant mark-sweep cycles took four times longer when full collections were triggered.

actions.actionDescription: Switched to ZGC collector with streaming byte buffers for PDF generation
actions.observation: Max GC pause dropped below 2ms under continuous load.
actions.explanation: Concurrent garbage collection removed stop-the-world pauses regardless of allocation rate.

title: Kafka consumer group rebalancing loop
symptoms: Order processing delayed by hours; consumer group constantly rebalancing; max.poll.interval.ms exceeded.
rootCause: Third-party fraud verification call took 35 seconds per batch, exceeding the default 30s poll timeout.
lesson: Process slow external IO asynchronously or increase max.poll.interval.ms proportionally.

actions.actionDescription: Reduced session.timeout.ms to 6000ms
actions.observation: Consumers were dropped even faster by coordinator, creating endless rebalance storm.
actions.explanation: Lower session timeout triggered premature heartbeats failures while worker threads were legitimately busy.

actions.actionDescription: Increased max.poll.interval.ms to 300000ms and reduced max.poll.records to 50
actions.observation: Consumer group stabilized and queue backlog cleared within 15 minutes.
actions.explanation: Smaller batches allowed consumers to finish processing well within the heartbeat deadline.

title: Hot key saturation crashing single Redis shard
symptoms: Redis shard CPU pegged at 100%; latency over 2000ms for flash-sale product metadata key.
rootCause: Over 80,000 requests/sec querying the exact same un-replicated product key.
lesson: Add client-side local caching (Caffeine) for super-hot read-only keys with short TTL.

actions.actionDescription: Deleted hot key to force cache invalidation
actions.observation: Backend PostgreSQL database CPU spiked to 100% within 3 seconds.
actions.explanation: Without the hot key in Redis, all 80,000 requests hit the underlying SQL query simultaneously.

actions.actionDescription: Introduced near-cache Caffeine layer in application with 15s TTL and key sharding
actions.observation: Redis shard CPU dropped to 18%; product page load time dropped to 15ms.
actions.explanation: In-memory JVM cache absorbed 99.8% of requests before they reached the shared Redis cluster.

title: Circuit breaker flapping during downstream bank gateway degradation
symptoms: Payment transactions intermittently failing with CircuitBreakerOpenException every 30 seconds.
rootCause: Circuit breaker ring buffer was too small (size 10), causing a single error to trip the breaker immediately.
lesson: Configure minimum number of calls (50+) and smooth moving average error rate thresholds.

actions.actionDescription: Force disabled circuit breaker completely in configuration
actions.observation: Worker thread pool became totally exhausted waiting on frozen bank endpoints.
actions.explanation: Disabling the circuit breaker caused all HTTP worker threads to hang indefinitely on slow bank responses until the entire service crashed.

actions.actionDescription: Adjusted sliding window size to 100 calls, failure rate threshold to 50%, and wait duration in open state to 60s
actions.observation: Circuit breaker transitioned cleanly and bank degradation was isolated gracefully.
actions.explanation: A representative window size prevented false positives from isolated transient errors.

title: TLS certificate expired on internal gRPC service mesh
symptoms: Orders API unable to talk to Inventory service; SSLHandshakeException: certificate expired.
rootCause: Cert-manager auto-renewal webhook was blocked by admission controller security policy.
lesson: Set up Prometheus alerts for certificates expiring within 14 days and test renewal pathways.

actions.actionDescription: Disabled TLS verification in gRPC client config across services
actions.observation: Service mesh proxy refused plaintext traffic and broke mutual TLS authentication.
actions.explanation: Istio Envoy sidecars strictly enforce mTLS in STRICT mode; disabling client TLS resulted in 100% immediate connection drops.

actions.actionDescription: Manually renewed CA bundle and patched cert-manager admission webhook permissions
actions.observation: mTLS handshakes succeeded immediately across all microservices.
actions.explanation: Valid certificate chain restored secure inter-service communication without compromising mesh policies.

title: Split-brain condition on Redis sentinel failover
symptoms: Inconsistent cache entries; multiple Redis instances claiming master role simultaneously.
rootCause: Network partition between availability zones separated two sentinel nodes from the master.
lesson: Deploy minimum 3 Sentinels across 3 distinct AZs and enforce min-replicas-to-write.

actions.actionDescription: Restarted Sentinel processes simultaneously across all nodes
actions.observation: Both masters continued to accept writes and state diverged further.
actions.explanation: Sentinels re-read conflicting cluster state upon boot without resolving underlying quorum.

actions.actionDescription: Configured min-replicas-to-write 1 and demoted isolated old master to replica
actions.observation: Single authoritative master established; data synchronized.
actions.explanation: Min-replicas-to-write prevents disconnected masters from accepting writes during network partitions.

title: RabbitMQ dead letter exchange queue flooding
symptoms: RabbitMQ broker memory alarm tripped; disk paging started; payment confirmation queue blocked.
rootCause: Malformed webhook payloads failed validation and were rejected without discarding or un-routing.
lesson: Always configure maximum queue length (x-max-length) and TTL for dead letter exchanges.

actions.actionDescription: Purged all queues including main transactional queues
actions.observation: Legitimate in-flight customer payments were lost and required manual database reconciliation.
actions.explanation: Blindly purging queues discarded unprocessed customer transactions along with the bad messages.

actions.actionDescription: Applied message TTL on dead-letter exchange and patched JSON validation schema
actions.observation: Broker memory alarm cleared and valid payment events resumed processing.
actions.explanation: Expiring bad messages freed RAM while schema fix prevented new validation loops.

title: CPU throttling due to overly aggressive Kubernetes cgroups limits
symptoms: p99 latency 6000ms while CPU usage reported only 45%; severe container throttling observed.
rootCause: CPU limit was set to 500m on multi-threaded Spring Boot application doing parallel stream operations.
lesson: Remove hard CPU limits on latency-sensitive Java workloads or size limits to multiple whole cores.

actions.actionDescription: Increased number of pod replicas from 5 to 20 without altering resource limits
actions.observation: Individual requests were still throttled during their 100ms CFS quota window.
actions.explanation: Horizontal scaling does not eliminate thread-level quota exhaustion on individual multi-threaded requests.

actions.actionDescription: Removed CPU limits and increased requests to 2000m with ActiveProcessorCount=2
actions.observation: p99 latency dropped from 6000ms to 45ms immediately.
actions.explanation: Eliminating CFS quota throttling allowed Java ForkJoinPool threads to run to completion without pauses.

title: Database replica replication lag exceeding 45 minutes
symptoms: Payment reconciliation reporting false missing orders; read queries returning stale data.
rootCause: Unindexed table migration on primary wrote 10 million row updates in a single giant transaction.
lesson: Execute large schema migrations in small batches and monitor Seconds_Behind_Master.

actions.actionDescription: Restarted MySQL replica server
actions.observation: Crash recovery on startup required re-parsing relay logs, increasing lag from 45 to 80 minutes.
actions.explanation: Abrupt restart forced InnoDB redo log replay during startup before replication SQL thread could even resume.

actions.actionDescription: Configured replica_parallel_workers=8 and replica_parallel_type=LOGICAL_CLOCK
actions.observation: Replication caught up to real-time within 6 minutes.
actions.explanation: Multi-threaded applier executed non-conflicting transactions in parallel across CPU cores.

title: OAuth token introspection endpoint latency spike
symptoms: All API requests timing out at 30 seconds during user authentication phase.
rootCause: Remote authorization server was degraded; orders API was validating every bearer token remotely without caching.
lesson: Use self-contained JWT tokens with local public key verification instead of remote opaque token introspection.

actions.actionDescription: Increased HTTP client connection timeout to 60 seconds
actions.observation: Tomcat thread pool hit 100% exhaustion in under 10 seconds; health checks failed.
actions.explanation: Holding threads open for 60 seconds consumed all server request threads, making the entire API totally unresponsive.

actions.actionDescription: Enabled local JWT verification with cached JWKS public keys and 5-minute introspection cache
actions.observation: Authentication time dropped to 0.4ms per request.
actions.explanation: Cryptographic signature check eliminated external network round-trips for token validation.

title: Serialization incompatibility following library version bump
symptoms: Cache reads throwing InvalidClassException: serialVersionUID mismatch on session data.
rootCause: UserSession class added a field without defining a static final serialVersionUID.
lesson: Explicitly define serialVersionUID on all cached domain models or use JSON serialization.

actions.actionDescription: Downgraded application deployment without clearing cache
actions.observation: Old instances threw errors when reading newer serialized objects already stored in Redis.
actions.explanation: Objects written by the new deployment remained unreadable to the old deployment.

actions.actionDescription: Migrated Redis serialization format to Jackson JSON and cleared user session namespace
actions.observation: Serialization errors ceased; sessions deserialized gracefully with backward compatibility.
actions.explanation: JSON text serialization is resilient to field additions and removals without JVM class version coupling.
